subject: One-time onramp grant + temporary rate carveout for SmallStone (exec approval request)
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot proposal + ask for short-term grant and discount

Hi Ari / Jenna —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together the small pilot plan that matches the latency-sensitive flows you showed (3 inference routes: chat, summarization, entity-extraction).

Two asks to get the pilot into customer testing next week:
- One-time onramp grant: $30k free credits applied to the first 60 days to help cover initial eval volume and embedding indexing.
- Introductory rate carveout: 15% off hosted per-token rates for months 1–3; revert to standard pricing afterward.

Rationale: This is a targeted, time-boxed concession to remove friction for the integration team and accelerate first-production signals. We expect a clear path to a small committed Dedicated pool if metrics look good (target: 50k queries/day by month 3).

Attached: SmallStone-Pilot-Plan.xlsx and usage-projection.csv.

Can you confirm if finance/legal need anything else to proceed? If this looks good I will loop in Marissa for the exec signoff and send the formal SOW.

Cheers,
Soojin

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding SmallStone's confirmation. Procurement has two simple questions; otherwise this is a clean pilot. Ask: can we approve a one-time $30k credit applied to hosted usage only and a 15% temporary on-invoice rate reduction for months 1–3?

Why I recommend it:
- Strategic fit: SmallStone is a fintech startup integrating AML/screening features; low regulatory risk but high expansion potential (platform + data ingestion).
- Clear upsell trigger: commit to Dedicated if steady-state QPS >40k/day within 90 days.
- Limited downside: credits are timeboxed and the discount reverts.

Attached a short kicker (SOW draft and usage projections).

If you prefer, I can tighten the expiry window to 45 days instead of 60.

Thanks,
Soojin
